items.label: All-Weather Durability
items.value: Patio furniture set features high-quality handwoven PE rattan with a galvanized steel tube frame, this outdoor dining set boasts exceptional weather resistance and UV protection, making it a reliable choice for outdoor spaces in any climat

items.label: Ergonomic Design
items.value: The dining chair's curved backrest and armrests follow ergonomic principles. With back height 34.3 in, width 20.5 in and seat width 18.8 in,this 5 piece patio furniture set provide perfect support and comfort for long meals

items.label: Versatility
items.value: Each dining table features a 1.5-inch umbrella hole with a matching cap for use with sunshades.The adjustable table leg design allows you to easily level the outdoor dining set on any surface,from deck to lawn

items.label: Easy-cleaning
items.value: Our patio table and chairs set features removable seat cushions for effortless wiping.The tabletop is made of scratch-resistant tempered glass,ensuring your patio dining set stays looking crisp and pristine throughout every season

items.label: After-sales Service
items.value: Our dining table set for 4 Shipped in 2 boxes, self-assembly required. Should you encounter missing or damaged parts,please contact us promptly with photos.Our after-sales team will respond and resolve the issue within 24 hours
